title: Dolor Amarus

sources.title: Dolor Amarus (passive feature)
markers: | summary = '''Dolor Amarus''' is a passive feature that deals extra damage when a weapon attack lands a critical hit.

summary: A +2 dagger. While this weapon is equipped, weapon critical hits gain 7 extra damage.

fields.Reported behavior: Copies of this passive stack. The pinned source reports no extra damage on unarmed critical hits or Throw attacks.
fields.Base value: 190 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
